items.difficulty_reason: 71 行、两向都写实的归纳论证：正向在局部把复形截成上有界，对「最高非零上同调度数」归纳——用有限型性（Cohomology 引理）在缩小后取自由模到最高上同调群的满射，作 distinguished triangle 把最高层切掉，对锥用归纳假设，再把三角形推前、用 i_*O_Z 伪凝聚与三选二性质收尾；反向把复形与推前互换、同一套归纳再走一遍。承重步骤（局部化、选满射、切层、推前、三选二）都在 span 内；3 处引用全跨章，作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-closed-push-pseudo-coherent (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 3142-3149

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the induction on the highest nonvanishing cohomology group that builds a surjection from a free module, cuts the complex by a distinguished triangle and pushes forward, and the reverse implication obtained by the same argument with the roles exchanged (source lines 3151-3221)
